name: Quote->Order convert fails on null PricingTermCount/EndDate
what_it_tests: Null PricingTermCount/EndDate on a TermDefined quote line propagates to the OrderItem at convert; native RLM blocks order activation of a termed line without EndDate + PTC; a root fix restores the Proration writer while the order-tier backstop only masks it
proc_mechanism: createOrderFromQuote copies null PTC to OrderItem; native RLM REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING ('PricingTermCount is required for Termed order products'); Fortra_OrderItem_Set_Dates V6 backstop stamps EndDate + PTC=1 on update only
expected_behavior: Root fix at quote tier so null never reaches order; convert succeeds and order activates without manual EndDate/PTC; backstop is emergency-only
test_setup: TermDefined quote line with null PTC + null EndDate, convert via Fortra_Quote_to_Order_Conversion -> Activate

prior_run.actual: After 2x Force-reprice, TermDefined QLI 0QLWC000003kjtG4AQ (SellingModelType=TermDefined, SubscriptionTerm=1, PeriodBoundary=Anniversary, Qty=5) PricingTermCount stays NULL (pre and post). Live V21 (9QBWC0000000oWH4AY, 127 steps) has only ONE ProrationMultiplier->PricingTermCount writer, gated by EvergreenanytimeprorationfilterLinelevel; NO TermDefined-gated Proration writer; StartProrationPeriod not used as any filter guard. Null PTC propagates to convert; only order-tier Fortra_OrderItem_Set_Dates V6 (active 301WC00000knsJNYAY) masks it.
prior_run.defectStep: TermDefined proration filter (Line level) + ProrationTermDefined writer (ProrationMultiplier->PricingTermCount) MISSING from active V21; only the Evergreen-gated Proration step survives
prior_run.regression: SC-3420 (guarded TermDefined Proration writer deployed/active in V16 per memory; lost in V16->V21 procedure churn)
prior_run.notes: defect_provenance SC-3411/3415/3406 = order-tier symptoms of the same quote-tier root SC-3420. Backstop Fortra_OrderItem_Set_Dates V6 still active so convert+activate would succeed (masked), but quote-tier expected_behavior NOT met. Aside: NetUnitPrice/UnitPrice came back 0 on this fixture line (list 5900 PBE not flowed) - separate from the PTC oracle, noted not conflated.
